```{r}
student_preferences_round_1_path <- "data/BA_01_Preferences_Students.txt"
number_topics <- 4
available_topic_ids <- 1:number_topics
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)

here::i_am("main.rmd")

```

```{r}
student_preferences_round_1 <- read_csv(
  file = here(student_preferences_round_1_path)
  )

student_preferences_round_1_long <- student_preferences_round_1 |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = preference_1:preference_5,
    names_to = "topic_id",
    names_prefix = "preference_",
    values_to = "rank")


# ---- Helper: coerce inputs & checks ----
validate_prefs <- function(preferences, objects) {
  req_cols <- c("student_id", "topic_id", "rank")
  if (!all(req_cols %in% names(preferences))) {
    abort("`preferences` must have columns: student_id, topic_id, rank (rank 1 = most preferred).")
  }
  preferences %>%
    mutate(
      student_id = as.character(student_id),
      topic_id = as.character(topic_id),
      rank = as.integer(rank)
    ) %>%
    filter(topic_id %in% objects) %>%
    arrange(student_id, rank)
}
```
